ACTION=A6
Rationale: The ego vehicle is currently traveling straight in its lane at 30 kph towards a static obstacle (vehicle at x=17.8m). To avoid a rear-end collision with the stationary obstacle ahead, the vehicle needs to perform an evasive maneuver or stop; looking at the available action set (A0 through A6), A6 typically corresponds to an emergency stop or full braking action.
